newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi shares end week mixed in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Saudi shares end week mixed in moderate trade.

text.p: Saudi shares ended last week mixed in moderate trade focused mainly on services sector shares, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) showed on Saturday.
The index ended at 164.35 points from 162.61 points a week earlier.
Of the 59 companies traded, 17 rose, 27 declined and 15 were unchanged.
Services sector shares accounted for 40 percent of trading volume which BFA put at four billion shares worth about 903 million riyals.

Amiantit was the star performer in the week with a 50.6 percent increase to 125 riyals from 83 riyals the previous week. Saudi Hotels gained 9.8 percent to 145 riyals from 132 and Zoujaj closed 9.7 percent better at 170 riyals from 155 riyals.
Thimar lost 10 percent, ending the week at 63 riyals from 70 riyals and Arriyadh Development lost 9.3 percent to 78 riyals from 86 riyals.
